verdict.rationale: Ashby ships Ashby Assistant, a built-in chat-based agent that lets users ask questions, take actions (update candidates, draft emails), and run custom agents for repeated workflows, respecting existing permissions, plus a Slack-embedded interface and an AI Notetaker add-on for automated interview delegation. These are first-party product docs describing genuine in-product AI delegation, though there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the assistant's real-world reliability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Ashby Assistant's task delegation quality, and detail on the scope/limits of 'custom agents' capability.
